answer_1.quote: In this paper, we aim to automatically generate Wikipedia abstracts based on the related documents ... we propose TWAG, a two-stage neural abstractive Wikipedia abstract generation model ...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of our model with ROUGE scores ...

answer_4.quote: We follow the experimental setup of ... and conduct a human evaluation consisting of two parts. The first part is a question‑answering (QA) scheme ... The second part is an evaluation over linguistic quality. We ask the participants to read different generated summaries from 3 perspectives and give a score of 1‑5 (Completeness, Fluency, Succinctness).
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators answer QA questions based on the generated abstracts and rate linguistic quality on completeness, fluency, and succinctness.
